mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER_MST ( USER_KEY, USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_EMAIL, USER_NAME, USER_RRM, PHONE_NUMBER, SOCIAL_LOGIN_YN, SOCIAL_PROVIDER, SOCIAL_PROVIDER_KEY, USER_NICKNAME, USER_PROFILE_SEQ, SIGNUP_DT, USER_INFO_UPDATE_DT, LAST_LOGIN_DT, PW_FAIL_CNT, USER_STATUS, LAST_STATUS_CHANGED_DT, USER_STATUS_CONTENT, LOGIN_TRY_CNT, LOGIN_AUTH, ADMIN_YN, WARN_CNT, BAN_CNT ) VALUES ( #{userKey}, #{userId}, #{userPw}, #{userEmail}, #{userName}, #{userRRM}, #{phoneNumber}, #{socialLoginYn}, #{socialProvider}, #{socialProviderKey}, #{userNickname}, 0, #{signupDt}, #{userInfoUpdateDt}, #{lastLoginDt}, 0, 'S', #{lastStatusChangedDt}, #{userStatusContent}, 0, #{loginAuth}, #{adminYn}, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_PW FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_NICKNAME = #{userNickname})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{userEmail})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_KEY = #{userKey})

SELECT USER_KEY, USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_EMAIL, USER_NAME, USER_RRM, PHONE_NUMBER, SOCIAL_LOGIN_YN, SOCIAL_PROVIDER, SOCIAL_PROVIDER_KEY, USER_NICKNAME, USER_PROFILE_SEQ, SIGNUP_DT, USER_INFO_UPDATE_DT, LAST_LOGIN_DT, PW_FAIL_CNT AS pwFailCount, USER_STATUS, LAST_STATUS_CHANGED_DT, USER_STATUS_CONTENT, LOGIN_TRY_CNT AS loginTryCount, LOGIN_AUTH, ADMIN_YN, WARN_CNT AS warnCount, BAN_CNT AS banCount FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT USER_KEY, USER_ID, USER_PW, USER_NICKNAME, USER_EMAIL, SIGNUP_DT, LOGIN_AUTH, ADMIN_YN, SOCIAL_LOGIN_YN FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_KEY = #{userKey}
SELECT USER_ID, FROM TB_USER_MST WHERE USER_EMAIL = #{email}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_USER_MST SET USER_PW = #{userPw}, USER_INFO_UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE USER_KEY = #{userKey}
